meta.name: tool_selection_probe
meta.purpose: Diagnostic only: does adding a sixth MCP tool (biobtree_variant) change which tool the model reaches for first? Not part of the scored benchmark; answers are not graded.
meta.expected_tool: the tool a competent agent should call first for this question
meta.note: Questions are phrased naturally; no tool names or hints appear in the text.
